headline: Approved changes to city debt management policy, including public art and Land Bank funding rules and removal of the $50,000 annual cap.
summary: Members approved changes to the city's debt management policy, 3-0. The changes remove pension obligation bond language, add charter referendum thresholds, and base public art and Land Bank contributions on general fund bond issues. Members also received updates on the school agreement, the police department, and the Expo Center, and discussed in-person meetings.
decisions: Approved changes to the city's debt management policy as presented, 3-0.
discussion: Public art and Land Bank funding: Members asked how the proposed calculation would change funding and whether the rules still match their original purpose. Staff said the proposal would increase contributions, and bonds would be issued only when the money is ready to be spent.

Bond term rule: Staff explained that the policy would allow some debt terms up to two years longer than an asset's useful life, mainly for bond bank loans to schools. Members asked about interest costs and were told the rule would apply only in specific cases.
School agreement with the city: Staff are documenting current city and school services, including their costs. Staff aim to finish by December, with committee discussion expected in January.

Police department and Expo Center: Members asked about the police department building design and site selection. Staff said the police project is further along, and the Expo Center project is behind it.

In-person meetings: Members supported returning to some in-person meetings, especially for budget discussions. Staff asked that hybrid options remain available for staff who prefer to attend remotely.

decision_evidence.quote: I'll take a motion to pass these changes as presented and as in the agenda. So moved. Second. ... And I'm yes. the motion passes.

decision_titles: Changes to the debt management policy
